Paragraph: "Look at those elephants bathing near the lotus beds, spraying water playfully over each other!"
Situation/Problem_Faced: Observing wild elephants bathing playfully in the lake.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama watches the social and playful behavior of the elephant herd.
Outcome/Resolution: He directs Lakshmana's attention to the powerful yet gentle scene.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Gaja-Lila (Playful majesty of elephants reflecting uninhibited natural strength)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: The playful bathing of elephants symbolizes strength at ease, moving freely in nature's grace.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Observing uninhibited, joyful animal interactions to temporarily interrupt personal grief.
